sources.title: On Affine Reachability Problems
sources.actual_reading: Pages 1-5: models, definitions of matrix/affine reachability, Proposition 1, Proposition 2 and its source-dependent matrix construction.
sources.use: Scope check only: fixed dimension does not mean the generator matrices are fixed. These results do not directly classify the fixed-p averaging semigroup.
sources.limits: The full paper and proofs outside the stated range were not independently audited. No 2026 literature-wide open-status claim is inferred from this 2020 paper. The local dual-normal theorem does not depend on an external reachability algorithm.
